subject.title: fix(build): add explicit ESM format to nodeBuildConfig for type module package

question: Should this defensive `nodeBuildConfig()` ESM pin land, and if so should the final merge metadata be changed so it does not close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91539?
rationale: The patch is technically safe and well scoped, but it no longer represents the source-backed fix for the linked issue, and the remaining risk is a maintainer-owned merge/cleanup choice rather than a code defect ClawSweeper should repair automatically.

options.title: Land with neutral merge text
options.body: Accept the no-op build-contract pin only if the final squash or merge text removes the issue-closing claim for the linked document-extract report.

options.title: Land as-is
options.body: Accept the small hardening change and intentionally allow GitHub closing metadata risk for the linked issue.

options.title: Close as unnecessary
options.body: Decline the defensive pin because current tsdown already emits ESM and the diagnostic fix lives in the merged inspect-shape PR.

recommendation.title: Land with neutral merge text
recommendation.body: Accept the no-op build-contract pin only if the final squash or merge text removes the issue-closing claim for the linked document-extract report.
